dry_decisions.decision: Reuse ScorecardContext, BoundedHttpCapture, captured responses and existing credential-safe Zyte transport. Keep pacing, hashing and hash_only retention shared.

Review and adopt the small tenant-bound anonymous capture helper with the explicit IPAA reader. BIPAC supplies a second client transport observation, but its empty arrays prove no populated scorecard schema.
Reuse existing helpers only when an original publisher-selected scorecard or action sheet is recovered. Advocacy campaign shells remain catalog evidence.

Normalize their metadata into the publisher inventory. Compare repeated observation/provenance records before adopting a shared type; retain archive-specific field locators and access meanings. Dated availability code remains separate from registered scorecard readers.
Retain source-time identities and exact republishing or successor relationships. Reuse existing reader scopes; do not publish the same rating twice under historical aliases.

Use existing DefaultReader, Docling/Ovis and data-shaped Gemini observations plus independent original review. Candidate comparisons and endorsements require a separately defined data shape; regional Carpenters requires its actual regional publisher attribution. Keep those private until canonical fit and source authority are established.

schema_findings: IPAA repeats and changes publisher member identities within item records. Preserve each source occurrence and its locator; do not choose one identity for the Congress.
A regional publisher is distinct from a national catalog candidate. Publication requires the actual source imprint and an explicit relationship.

Candidate comparisons and mixed federal/state endorsement lists are documented unsupported shapes for the current congressional-member scorecard model. Private extracted data remains available for a later deliberate extension.
Selected archive metadata can be complete while the underlying scorecard remains unrecovered. Keep completeness scoped to the actual input.
Retirement requires a dated publisher closure statement. Failed requests, empty arrays and older holdings establish no retirement.
review_decisions: Reuse existing PDF completeness and private-retention helpers; corrected callback failures refuse with credential-safe errors. The reviewed repair preserves all private extracted outcomes and does not admit canonical rows.

Regional Carpenters marks fit the existing metric-free model after actual regional publisher attribution and scope qualification. Candidate comparisons and mixed federal/state endorsements require a separate deliberately scoped model.
Keep catalog probes, source-time identity relationships and unsupported private-grid utilities outside the supported-adapter registry. BIPAC remains unregistered.

Current disposition reconciliation preserves the original task-result labels. Liberty Lobby retirement has a dated original notice; regional Carpenters needs attribution and qualification, not a schema change; MFL/NWPC remain candidate/endorsement scope; UTU full-grid absence and its isolated 2008 rating claim remain distinct. No new qualification, publication, registry enablement or API claim.
